desc:
Build a fort before the lights go out. 🔦

You noclipped into the Backrooms: endless yellow halls, damp carpet, the buzz of the lights. Grab anything you can carry, from couches to fridges, and wall yourself in with your friends.

When the lights die, the Facelings hunt.
🆕 The Hound hunts by sound. Deathmoths are drawn to your light. The Skin-Stealer wears a friend's face.

How many days can you last?

🛠️ Hundreds of things to grab and build with
👥 Better with friends
🐐 Join we the goats! for a free Golden Goat
